name: Get Password Policy (SA)
help: Retrieve password policy and account lockout settings from a server or domain
long_help: Uses NetUserModalsGet to retrieve password and lockout policies. Displays: minimum password length, maximum/minimum password age, forced logoff time, password history length, lockout duration, lockout observation window, and lockout threshold.

arguments.name: server
arguments.desc: Target server or domain controller to query (default: local system or domain)
